summary: Hoeksche Chips is the consumer brand of Hoeksche Hoeve B.V., a farm in 's-Gravendeel in the Hoeksche Waard, Netherlands, that grows its own potatoes and fries and packs skin-on potato chips on the farm. Three local arable farmers pooled their potato growing in 2002, and the first bag of chips was produced in 2004.
ownership: Founded by three Hoeksche Waard arable farmers
products: Skin-on potato chips from the farm's own potatoes
Flavours: Salt & Balsamico Vinegar, Paprika, Puur, Ribbel
Flavours: Truffel, Zeezout, Zwarte Peper, Barbecue
Smaak van het Seizoen (flavour of the season)
markets: Specialty shops, farm shops, delicatessens, cheese shops and gift shops throughout the Netherlands
Business ordering for shops, specialty stores and hospitality
certifications: BRC Global Standard for Food Safety (grade AA)
facts: The farm has grown its own potatoes for more than 100 years
Chips available in shops across the Netherlands since 2005
Fried in 100% High Oleic sunflower oil at 130–160 °C
Farm largely runs on solar energy from its own panels since 2010
